_notes: Modes and words of the write-time checks (hooks/shared/evidence/, hooks/write_checks.py, hooks/amendment_gate.py). None asks a model. Change a mode here with no code change: 'off' runs nothing, 'shadow' logs only, 'advisory' notes, 'gate' returns. Mode words are read without regard to case and 'enforce' reads 'gate'; when this file cannot be read, is malformed or names no known mode, each check uses its shipped mode (hooks/shared/evidence/ledger.py DEFAULT_MODES) and one note line goes to stderr.

handoff_evidence = 'advisory': a HANDOFF item with a parsed count that is NO-RUN, MISMATCH or EXIT is never returned: the HANDOFF is stored, the writer gets one note line and the lead gets the item lines at acceptance. 'off' turns the run-count check off.

uncertainty_disposition = 'advisory': an uncertainty item with no leading 'fixed:', 'known-limit:' or 'not-applicable:' (after an optional bullet and severity tag), one item per line, is stored; the writer gets one line and the lead the item lines at acceptance.
amendment_gate = 'note': an amend_<n> with no disposition in handoff.amendments is a note, never a return. 'enforce' returns each key once; 'shadow' logs only.

commit_rule = 'off' (the shipped default): no commit message is checked. 'gate' returns, every time, a commit message with AI attribution, a body, more than one sentence or a word from commit_rule.deny_words (hooks/shared/commit_rules.py); an empty deny_words list checks no words. Every return is logged (checks/shadow.jsonl, kind write_gate) and counted by repact-report.

ref_dispositions = 'enforce': a HANDOFF write on a team task that carries project tasks (ptask: links written by `repact-task start --ptask`, or metadata.project_task / metadata.refs) is returned every time until handoff.refs disposes of each ('done: <evidence>', 'partial: <what is left>', 'deferred: <why>', 'dropped: <why>'); the acceptance bridge closes the 'done' ones and reports the rest. A ref the task only names in its text is a note. 'note' never returns; 'off' runs nothing.

rejection_shape = 'enforce': a TaskUpdate that writes a key ending in _rejection is returned unless the key is handoff_rejection or teachback_rejection and the value is {reason, corrections, since, revision_number, rev} or null (hooks/amendment_gate.py, rules in hooks/shared/amendments.py rejection_shape_problem). It does not follow amendment_gate's mode. 'note' never returns; 'off' skips it; a missing or unknown word reads as enforce.
